faqs.q: Sec. 54-35. - MTC Part 6 "Signals - Signs - Markings" amended.
faqs.a:
The Model Traffic Code is hereby amended by amending subsection (1) of section 615
               of Part 6 in its entirety to read as follows:
615. School zones - increase in penalties for moving traffic violations.
(1)
Any person who commits a moving traffic violation in a school zone is subject to the
                  increased penalties and surcharges imposed by section 1705(5).
(
Ord. No. 4384, § 2, 4-15-2013
)
